property_summary: If play is called with the correct ticket amount (10) and does not revert, then either the pot increases by 10 (no payout) or the pot becomes 0 (payout), and in the payout case the contract's balance decreases by exactly FEE_AMOUNT (1) compared to before the call plus transferred payout amount — equivalently, when pot becomes 0 the contract balance after equals bal_before - (pot_before + 10) + 0 (i.e. it decreased by pot_before + 10) and the bank received exactly 1 more than before is not directly observable so we instead assert balance change equals -(pot_before + 10) + 0 — simplified: when call succeeds with amount 10 then either pot_after == pot_before + 10 or (pot_after == 0 && bal_after + 1 == bal_before - (0))
